data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003 claims torn-tail repair is fifth priority because test_torn_append.py provides partial coverage, lowering marginal risk. But the problem context requires ordering justified by blast radius: a torn tail that escapes repair *corrupts the append-only record* — the highest-severity category. A target that deprioritizes a record-corrupting failure below lower-blast-radius gaps (untested routing functions, census discrepancies) violates the required blast-radius ordering. Partial coverage does not reduce blast radius; the guard dying still corrupts the record, so it must rank above mere routing rot or observability gaps.
